changesProposed.name: 1X Technologies

verified.name: 1X Technologies
verified.description: Norwegian-American robotics and artificial intelligence company developing general-purpose humanoid robots for home environments. The company manufactures humanoid robots including EVE for industrial use and NEO for domestic applications.
verified.notes: Company was originally founded as Halodi Robotics in 2014 and rebranded as 1X Technologies in 2022. Series A2 funding of $23.5M raised in March 2023 (source 2). Series B funding of $100M raised in January 2024 (source 2). Total raised calculation: $23.5M + $100M = $123.5M. Source 0 and 1 describe a different company (wire and cable distributor also named 1X Technologies LLC based in Sheridan, WY) and are not applicable to the robotics company.

current.name: Agility Robotics
current.founder: Jonathan Hurst, Damion Shelton, Mikhail Jones

verified.name: Agility Robotics
verified.description: American humanoid robotics company that develops Digit, a commercially deployed bipedal robot for warehouse and logistics automation. The company was spun out from Oregon State University's Dynamic Robotics Lab in 2015.
verified.notes: Company announced plan to go public through merger with Churchill Capital Corp XI (announced June 24, 2026). Wikipedia notes a rebrand to 'Agility' on March 5, 2026. Sources do not provide specific total funding amount or current valuation figures to verify the database entry values.

changesProposed.name: Nano Nuclear Energy

verified.name: NANO Nuclear Energy
verified.description: Advanced nuclear energy company developing microreactor technologies including KRONOS MMR, ZEUS, and LOKI, along with nuclear fuel fabrication, transportation, and space applications.
verified.notes: Company is publicly listed on NASDAQ under ticker NNE. Sources claim to be 'the first nuclear microreactor company to be listed publicly in the U.S.' Database entry references 'Jay Jiang Yu' as founder and valuation/raise figures, but these are not verified in provided sources. Source [2] is about Valar Atomics (different company) and was not used. Founded year (2022) and total_raised ($600M+) from database entry cannot be verified from these sources.
